seo.title: Floris Suite Hotel Curaçao: Adults-Only Piscadera Bay Honeymoon 2026
seo.description: Adults-only Jan des Bouvrie design hotel on Piscadera Bay, all-suite. Honest 2026 verdict, real cost, best suite, 7-night Curaçao itinerary.

content.verdict: Floris Suite Hotel is the Jan des Bouvrie-designed adults-only on Piscadera Bay — the calm leeward-coast inlet 8 minutes west of Willemstad. The 72 all-suite property is the work of the late Dutch designer Jan des Bouvrie (the modernist behind Aldo Bakker, Linteloo, and a generation of Dutch interior design), and the resort is essentially a Bouvrie design portfolio set into a tropical garden: white-walled suites, dark hardwood, sculptural lighting, the clean Bouvrie geometry against the Caribbean palms. The beach is a small private cove (Floris guests share access with the adjacent Hilton, with imported sand and a small reef). For honeymoon couples drawn to Dutch design and the all-suite kitchenette flexibility — and willing to trade beach-perfection for proximity to Willemstad — Floris is the unique-in-Curaçao design-led adults-only.
content.best_room: All 72 rooms are suites with kitchenettes — there is no standard category. The signature pick is the Junior Suite with Pool View — Bouvrie's clean white-and-dark-wood interior facing the property's signature lap pool. For privacy upgrade, the One-Bedroom Suite has a larger living area and the most-coveted Garden View Suites face the lush plantings rather than the parking side. The Penthouse with private rooftop terrace is the rare top tier — book months ahead for honeymoon dates.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Arrival on Piscadera Bay
itinerary_7_nights.description: Fly into Hato International (CUR), 15-minute private transfer south to Piscadera Bay. Settle into the Junior Suite, use the kitchenette to stock breakfast supplies from the Floris boutique, and walk down to the shared Piscadera private beach for sunset. First dinner at the on-site restaurant or 5 minutes to the Hilton's beachside Promenade.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Pastel Willemstad Walking Day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Ten-minute taxi to Punda — Queen Emma floating bridge, the Handelskade row of pastel merchant houses, Mikve Israel-Emanuel (1732), Plasa Bieu for keshi yena and stewed iguana lunch, Mama Mello's market. Cross to Otrobanda for Kura Hulanda museum on Atlantic slave-trade history. Return to Piscadera by 5pm. Evening at Pietermaai (Mosa, Ginger, BijBlauw).

itinerary_7_nights.title: Klein Curaçao Day Trip
itinerary_7_nights.description: Full-day catamaran from Spanish Water (Floris arranges Mermaid or BlueFinn pickup) east to uninhabited Klein Curaçao — the white-sand snorkel-water bucket-list. Lighthouse, abandoned shipwrecks, two snorkel stops, lunch on board, return 5:30pm.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Mushroom Forest Dive Day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive west 45 minutes to Westpunt for Ocean Encounters' two-tank morning dive at the iconic Mushroom Forest (giant coral mushrooms 15-25m, parrotfish, turtles). Non-divers snorkel the Blue Room sea cave. Lunch at Sol Food on Westpunt beach. Afternoon at Playa Kenepa Grandi for the most-photographed Caribbean-side beach.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Curaçao Liqueur + Hato Caves
itinerary_7_nights.description: Morning at Landhuis Chobolobo — the 1896 plantation house where original Curaçao blue liqueur is distilled. Free tasting of clear, blue, red, green, and amber liqueurs. Drive 20 minutes to Hato Caves for the 200,000-year-old limestone formations with Caquetio Arawak petroglyphs. Spa appointment at Floris in the late afternoon.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Jan Thiel Beach-Club Day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Twenty-minute drive east to Jan Thiel Bay — Curaçao's beach-club scene. Lunch at Karakter or Zanzibar, swim in the protected cove, sundowners at Tinder Beach. Curaçao's social scene is concentrated here on weekend afternoons. Return to Floris for a quiet kitchenette-suite evening.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Final Pool Morning & Departure
itinerary_7_nights.description: Final breakfast on the suite terrace, last swim in the Bouvrie lap pool, and 15-minute transfer back to Hato International. Floris's central west-coast position keeps the departure transition smooth.

caveats: The Piscadera beach is shared with the adjacent Hilton (not exclusively Floris) and is small — couples wanting long beach walks should plan day-trips to Kenepa Grandi.
Floris is not on the beach itself — it is a 3-minute walk down to the shared Piscadera private beach; couples expecting beachfront-suite access should look at Papagayo or Baoase.
The 4-star Floris is not all-inclusive and not on the 5-star polish of Baoase — couples comparing to ultra-luxury should set expectations.
All-suite kitchenette layout is a strong fit for self-catering couples but the on-site dining is limited — the property is essentially a quiet design retreat, not a full-service resort.

faqs.question: Good for honeymooners?
faqs.answer: Floris is the Dutch-design adults-only option on Curaçao — Jan des Bouvrie interiors, all-suite layout with kitchenettes, the calm Piscadera Bay setting, 8 minutes from Willemstad. Couples drawn to design-led minimalism, the all-suite privacy, and a quiet not-on-the-beach setting find it the canonical Curaçao design honeymoon.

faqs.question: Best time to visit?
faqs.answer: Curaçao is below the hurricane belt — Floris operates consistently year-round. January-April is the dry-season peak: 28-30°C, breezy, sunny. May-June and November are excellent shoulder months. Even September-October is open and operating well.

faqs.question: Book in advance?
faqs.answer: Junior Suites with Pool View and the rare Penthouse Suite book 3 months ahead for the December-April peak. One-Bedroom Suites have more flexibility. Christmas, Valentine's, and Dutch school holidays drive the predominantly-Dutch guest demand.

faqs.question: Adults-only?
faqs.answer: Yes — Floris Suite Hotel is strictly adults-only (18+). Couples-only and small-group adult travellers are the dominant demographic. The atmosphere is quiet by design.

faqs.question: Best room type?
faqs.answer: Junior Suite Pool View for the signature Bouvrie design experience facing the lap pool. One-Bedroom Suite for more space. Penthouse with private rooftop terrace for the rare top tier. All categories have kitchenettes — confirm the bed configuration (King vs Twin) at booking.

faqs.question: How to get there?
faqs.answer: Hato International (CUR) is 15 minutes north of Piscadera Bay by taxi (around $25). Direct flights from JFK (American, JetBlue), Miami (American), Newark (United), Atlanta (Delta seasonal), Amsterdam (KLM and TUI daily). Floris arranges transfers on request.
